Chapter 2: The Net Loft

By noon the sky had turned the colour of slate. Maren pulled on her yellow storm coat and climbed the ladder to the net loft, where Tobias was mending a torn net under the round window.

"Harl was right," Tobias said without looking up. "The fishing boats are all coming back early."

Maren lit the lamp above the bench. Outside, the first heavy drops began to hit the roof, and somewhere below a door banged in the wind.

They worked in silence until the light was gone.
